name: Early IT Summer Camp (University of Cincinnati)
org: University of Cincinnati School of Information Technology
what_you_do: Attend a free, in person day camp on UC's main campus. Learn cybersecurity, software development, game development and data and cloud technologies. Hear from IT leaders. Build a team project with a college student mentor.
who_can_apply: High school students from rising 9th grade through rising 12th grade who like technology. In person camp only, and only domestic students are accepted right now.
pay_detail: Free to attend. A light breakfast and lunch are provided each day. No pay.
duration: Three weeks, Monday to Friday, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. The page lists June 1 to June 18 and does not print the year.
deadline_text: The camp page says registration is open and that the camp is first come, first served and spots fill up fast. It does not print a deadline or the year, so confirm the dates with the Early IT team.
how_to_apply: Use the Register Here link on the Early IT Summer Camp page. Tell them in your application if cost or lack of resources could keep you from taking part. Questions: ucearlyit@ucmail.uc.edu. There is a parent or guardian orientation on Zoom.
notes: Drop off is at Teacher-Dyer Complex, Room 160 (University Circle), between 8:30 and 10 a.m. with pick up 4:00 to 4:30 p.m. The FAQ says the camp runs over two weeks in one answer and the page says three weeks, so confirm the length.
